description: Frozen ledger of cell families that a registered apply_patch write targets while no registered write ever produces a base value for them (no set, append or transition writer). An apply_patch needs a base, and event-auth-state-resolution.md section 9.3.1.2 forbids closing the gap with a registered initial_value: the base must come from a registered create or genesis write. Adopted 2026-09-07 by review/spec-open/2026-09-07-1305-four-apply-patch-targets-have-no-registered-producer.md, which also records the convergence decision each entry still needs. This list only shrinks; a new entry is a defect, not a baseline update.

families_without_base_producer.note: control-plane cas_register; its settled value is null until the first patch, so the object's truth is defined by an update rather than by a create. Highest priority of the four.
ak.strand.create writes ak.component.strand.object.v1 instead, so create and update land on different families.
no create or genesis writer registers a base for the tracks subtree.
ak.view.create writes ak.component.view.create.v1 and ak.view.reconcile a third family; the update and reconcile subjects are also a bare string rather than id:view.
